_comment: Chainlink tokenized-equity price feeds on Robinhood Chain. Read with latestRoundData() over your Alchemy RPC — free, and it is the same price the chain itself uses. Add the rest from https://docs.chain.link/data-feeds/tokenized-equity-feeds/robinhood (33 total; paste the Standard Proxy address, not the SVR one).
_note: These feeds are 24/5. When US equity markets are closed they hold the last published price and stop heartbeating — that is expected, not a fault.
